func NewHandler[AEnvelope runtime.Of[ATag], BEnvelope runtime.Of[BTag], ATag any, BTag any](handler Handler[AEnvelope, BEnvelope], options runtime.ServerOptions) (http.Handler, error)
func Serve[AEnvelope runtime.Of[ATag], BEnvelope runtime.Of[BTag], ATag any, BTag any](ctx context.Context, conn duplex.Conn, options runtime.Options, handler Handler[AEnvelope, BEnvelope]) (*runtime.Peer, error)
type Handler[AEnvelope any, BEnvelope any] interface{Look(ctx context.Context, remote *Remote[AEnvelope, BEnvelope], params protocol.Mine[AEnvelope]) (protocol.Both[AEnvelope, BEnvelope], error)}
type Remote[AEnvelope any, BEnvelope any] struct{Peer *runtime.Peer}
